headline: Applications Invited for 90 Anganwadi Posts in Goa
summary: Applications have been invited for 90 Anganwadi worker positions offered on a monthly honorarium basis.

headline: RGP President Files Police Complaint Against Ajay Kholkar
summary: Revolutionary Goans Party president Shavina Shirodkar has filed police complaints at Margao and Anjuna over alleged derogatory remarks made by Ajay Kholkar. She has demanded a written public apology and strict action against him.

headline: Karwar Naval Staffer Dies in Canacona Road Crash
summary: A 23-year-old Punjab native working at the Karwar naval base died on the spot after his two-wheeler hit a truck at Pole, Canacona. The pillion rider sustained injuries and is receiving hospital treatment.

headline: All Mapusa Market Fire Hydrants Found Non-Functional
summary: A fire safety inspection by the Directorate of Fire and Emergency Services revealed that all five fire hydrants in Mapusa Market are non-functional. The check was conducted following the recent fire incident at Vasco market.

headline: Two Arrested in Ponda with Ganja Worth ₹7.18 Lakh
summary: The Anti-Narcotic Cell arrested two men from Bihar at the KTC Bus Stand in Ponda with 7.187 kg of suspected ganja valued at ₹7.18 lakh. The contraband was found hidden inside a black polythene bag.

headline: 53 Goa Groups Join World Konkani Music Convention in Mangaluru
summary: Fifty-three groups from Goa are participating in the first World Konkani Music Mega Convention in Mangaluru, attended by Chief Minister Pramod Sawant. Thousands of singers are performing in a 12-day singing marathon attempting a Guinness record.

headline: Brothers Granted Bail in ₹73 Lakh Senior Citizen Fraud
summary: A Margao court has granted bail to two brothers accused of defrauding a visually impaired senior citizen from Navelim of ₹73 lakh. Both accused were instructed to furnish a personal bond of ₹1 lakh each.

headline: Goa Government Appeals to Supreme Court Over ST Reservation
summary: The Goa government has petitioned the Supreme Court against the High Court's interim order halting the notification of estimated ST population figures. Tribal Welfare Minister Ramesh Tawadkar expressed optimism about getting an order before the next High Court hearing.

headline: Karnataka Farmers Renew Demands for Kalasa-Banduri Project
summary: Hundreds of farmers in Karnataka have renewed protests demanding the implementation of the Kalasa-Banduri water diversion projects. Goa continues to oppose the project over concerns regarding water security and the Mhadei river's ecology.

headline: GCZMA to Map Tiswadi's Khazan Lands Using Drone LiDAR
summary: The Goa Coastal Zone Management Authority has invited expressions of interest to map Khazan lands using UAV-based LiDAR technology. A pilot study will focus on Morombi-O-Pequeno village in Tiswadi taluka.
